R package for the analysis and visualization of food web data. Created by Reuman lab
student [Lawrence Hudson](../../../people.qmd#lawrence-hudson).

- Source: <https://github.com/quicklizard99/cheddar/>
- CRAN: <https://cran.r-project.org/web/packages/cheddar/index.html>

L.N. Hudson, R. Emmerson, G. Jenkins, K. Layer, M.E. Ledger, D. Pichler, M. Thompson, E. O’Gorman, G. Woodward, D.C. Reuman. 2013. Cheddar – analysis and visualization of ecological communities in R. Methods in Ecology and Evolution 4, 99-104. doi: 10.1111/2041-210X.12005. Available open access.

People: [Lawrence Hundson](../../../people.qmd#lawrence-hudson), Dan Reuman
